subject: Air freight quote request – NBO import
body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Our buyer in Nairobi, KE, is importing furniture samples from us in Germany, and I am arranging the flight for their import. Could you please quote the cheapest air freight option to NBO for this import shipment?

The shipment consists of 11 pieces, with a gross weight of 1061 kg and a total volume of 5.97 cbm. It will be ready for pickup on 2026-11-26 at our site in Duisburg, Germany, postcode 47914.

Please arrange the truck from our site to the departure airport and include the pickup and trucking in your all-in price in EUR.

Thank you for your assistance.

Kind regards
Anna Sonnberg
Head of Purchasing and Logistics
Sonnberg Kaffeeroesterei GmbH

classification.reasoning: The sender is requesting an all-in air freight quote for a new shipment to Nairobi.
